metadata.case_name: CHAN KAM FAI v. 李志傑經營之惠林運輸公司

plaintiff.occupation_before: driver and delivery worker for furniture
plaintiff.occupation_after: delivery worker (delivering food and grocery items)

injuries.description: comminuted fracture of the distal phalanx of the left big toe
source: As a result of the accident, the Plaintiff was suffering from comminuted fracture of the distal phalanx of the left big toe with minimal displacement of the fracture fragments and soft tissues swelling around the fracture.

injuries.description: capillary and lymphatic injury causing left big toe swelling
source: The Plaintiff was referred to and consulted Dr Chang Shao on 27 May 2006, who diagnosed that the Plaintiff suffered from capillary and lymphatic injury causing left big toe swelling.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of blood vessels at ankle or foot level

manifestations.description: reduced flexion at the first metatarsal phalangeal joint
total loss of flexion and extension at the interphalangeal joint
on-and-off needle pain and numbness in his left big toe
numbness in his left big toe
The Plaintiff’s left big toe will be painful during change of weather and while jumping or running.
Due to the swelling over the left big toe, he could not bear weight on his left foot and he had to sit on wheelchair for mobilization.
He was only able to bear weight on his left foot in or about September 2006.

treatments_received.treatment: Accident and Emergency treatment at Prince of Wales Hospital
source: The Plaintiff was sent to the Accident and Emergency Department of the Prince of Wales Hospital for treatment immediately after the accident.
Thereafter, the Plaintiff received treatment from ADEC Medical Centre and was referred to JP Physiotherapy Clinic for treatment.
Thereafter, the Plaintiff received treatment from ADEC Medical Centre and was referred to JP Physiotherapy Clinic for treatment.
The Plaintiff was referred to and consulted Dr Chang Shao on 27 May 2006, who diagnosed that the Plaintiff suffered from capillary and lymphatic injury causing left big toe swelling.

treatments_received.treatment: follow-up consultation at ADEC Medical Centre (16 July 2007)
source: At the last follow-up consultation at ADEC Medical Centre on 16 July 2007, physical examination revealed reduced flexion at the first metatarsal phalangeal joint and total loss of flexion and extension at the interphalangeal joint.

losses.description: Reduced flexion at the first metatarsal phalangeal joint and total loss of flexion and extension at the interphalangeal joint; on-and-off needle pain and numbness in left big toe.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Left big toe painful during change of weather and while jumping or running; pain on jumping or running.
Reduction in income and disadvantage in the labour market because he cannot carry heavy objects like furniture as before and his efficiency and working capacity are affected.
